resources.string: Cancelled: saving the part that is already done (it is encoded again as a short clip).
Partial export saved to Movies/TakipliOynat/%1$s (first %2$s s).
Recording: play the video, pinch to zoom, drag to move. Tap Record again to stop; the take replaces the automatic framing for that part.
A tapped spot or drawn region is followed as it is. Body-part presets do not apply. Size and smoothness are in the Camera tab.
Turn on Record, press Play, then use two fingers on the video: pinch to zoom and drag at the same time. Use the speed slider to record in slow motion.
Cancelled: preparing the part that is already scanned …
Cancelled after %1$d samples (first %2$s s scanned). The processed part can be previewed and exported; the interrupted scan is kept for resuming.
Cancelled after %1$d samples (first %2$s s scanned), but nobody was found at the picked point in that part, so there is nothing to export. The interrupted scan is kept for resuming.
Cancelled scan: only the first %2$s s were processed. Preview and export cover that part.
A–B: seek to a frame, tap A or B to set it. Only the part between them is scanned, tracked and exported (leave empty for the whole clip). Tap your target on a frame inside A–B.
The A–B range is invalid: B must be after A, and the frame you tap on must lie between them.
A–B scan: only %1$s–%2$s s were processed. Preview and export cover that part.
